name: Scramble and lock title
what: Your footage blurs and darkens at its edges while a big white title flickers as random letters that lock into place one by one from the left; the title then shrinks and rises to the top and an open yellow padlock rises from the bottom and snaps shut beneath it.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f30: the footage blurs (to f22) and its edges darken; f16-f28 the title fades in out of a blur as flickering random letters (a new letter every 2 f); f28-f44 the letters lock in one by one from the left, one every 2 f; f46-f66 the title shrinks to 0.6x and rises to the top (decelerating, small overshoot, settling at 0.65x by f80); f80-f90 an open padlock rises from the bottom (decelerating, tilted 15 degrees), f90-f98 the shackle drops in and the body swings straight with a small bounce; it floats a few pixels to f150.

tracks.name: footage
tracks.what: blurs and darkens at its edges
tracks.easing: linear to f22, accelerating vignette (measured table)

tracks.name: scramble
tracks.what: the title fades in out of a blur as random letters, a new one every 2 f

tracks.name: lock in
tracks.what: the letters lock in left to right, one every 2 f

tracks.name: title up
tracks.what: the title shrinks to 0.6x and rises to the top, then eases back to 0.65x

tracks.name: padlock rises
tracks.what: an open padlock rises from the bottom of the frame, tilted

tracks.name: padlock snaps shut
tracks.what: the shackle drops in and the body swings straight with a small bounce
tracks.easing: ease-out with a small overshoot (measured table)

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the padlock floats a few pixels (the film grain moves)
